_comment: Text pane boxes of the layout-bound strings (src/layouts/*.json), keyed by the string id without its '#<line>'. Read once from the decrypted System Settings applet (0004001000022000, romfs/up_LZ.bin, LZ11 + DARC) with the owner's tools/bclyt.py: width in screen pixels, font_size = the pane's fontSizeX (the system font is drawn at fontSize / 25). A new layout spec in the owner's repo needs its pane here; until then its strings show their width only.
